annotations.title: Google ads run by an advertiser

description: For competitive ad research: lists ads a company has run on Google, as published in the Google Ads Transparency Center, newest first. Give 1-3 domains (nike.com), advertiser IDs (AR...) or Transparency Center advertiser URLs (a domain lookup can also return other advertisers that Google associates with that domain; an advertiser ID returns only that account). Returns advertiser, format (text, image, video), first and last shown dates, days running, whether it is still running, a preview image link and the Transparency Center link. Filter by region, platform, format and recency. Billed per ad returned.

date_from.description: Only ads shown on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Only ads shown on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD (needs date_from).

last_shown_within_days.description: Only ads shown in the last N days (1-2 = running now).

limit.description: Ads per target (default 20, max 40). Billed per ad returned.

region.description: Where the ads were shown: country code (US, DE), country name, or "anywhere" (default US).

targets.description: 1-3 domains, advertiser IDs (AR followed by digits) or adstransparency.google.com advertiser URLs.

name: google_advertiser_ads
title: Google ads run by an advertiser
